features.label: Radial impact structure
features.description: A circular center and material extending outward distinguish the Cat's Eye crater from a nebula-like cloud.

explanation: The visual resemblance is misleading: this is impact topography on Mercury, read through circular and radial geometry.
colorMethod: Enhanced planetary color and contrast make surface materials and ejecta easier to compare; they are not a natural-color view.
whyItMatters: This reading separates what the image shows directly from what instruments, processing and context allow us to infer.
